Browser libraries LIBBY loads on demand (Word, Excel and PDF files), copied from npm at the versions LIBBY pinned,
so the site loads no third-party scripts (Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'self').
  docx 9.6.1 (MIT)  jszip 3.10.1 (MIT or GPL-3.0)  xlsx 0.18.5 (Apache-2.0)  pdfjs-dist 3.11.174 (Apache-2.0)
